dna.outline: hand-drawn thin black or sepia ink, loose but intentional
dna.wash: soft translucent watercolor wash, visible paper texture
dna.lighting: soft diffuse light from upper left, no harsh shadows
dna.edge_handling: subject floats on cream background, edges fade to paper

intensity_levels.light: pale wash, mostly cream, hints of color
intensity_levels.medium: balanced wash, visible color but paper dominates
intensity_levels.deep: saturated watercolor, still transparent, paper visible through color

emotional_wash_intensity.sorrow: medium-deep navy and sepia, heavier wash
emotional_wash_intensity.hope: light-medium, cream dominant, sky blue hints
emotional_wash_intensity.tension: medium, burnt orange accents, dark navy shadows
emotional_wash_intensity.peace: light, cream heavy, soft sepia and sky blue
emotional_wash_intensity.triumph: medium, warm gold and burnt orange, cream sky
emotional_wash_intensity.contemplation: light-medium, sepia dominant, cream negative space
